effect.name: GM CRT Phosphor
effect.desc: Curved CRT optics with RGB phosphor triads, beam scan, bloom, mask softness and edge vignette.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,q=uv-.5;float r2=dot(q,q);vec2 w=.5+q*(1.0+curvature*r2);vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv),c=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(w,0.0,1.0));float x=mod(floor(w.x*acScreenSize.x/max(phosphorScale,.01)),3.0);vec3 mask=vec3(1.0-maskStrength);if(x<.5)mask.r=1.0;else if(x<1.5)mask.g=1.0;else mask.b=1.0;float scan=1.0-scanlines*(.5+.5*cos(w.y*acScreenSize.y*3.14159265/max(phosphorScale,.01)));vec3 rgb=c.rgb*mask*scan+c.rgb*c.rgb*bloom*(1.0-scan);rgb*=1.0-vignette*smoothstep(.15,.6,r2);float valid=step(0.0,w.x)*step(w.x,1.0)*step(0.0,w.y)*step(w.y,1.0);gl_FragColor=mix(src,vec4(rgb,c.a),mixAmount*valid);}
